sloka: महोदरवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसैः परिवारितः ।कुम्भकर्णो महातेजाः सम्प्रतस्थे महाबलः ।। ६.६०.८४ ।।।।
transliteration: mahodaravacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ ।kumbhakarṇo mahātejāḥ sampratasthe mahābalaḥ ।। 6.60.84 ।।।।

translations.english: All those night rangers, approaching the tenheaded king seated on an excellent se at greeted with folded hands and said.
